summary: InflaRx N.V., a German-domiciled Nasdaq-listed biopharma, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 6, 2026, announcing peer-reviewed publication in Clinical Pharmacology in Drug Development of first-in-human Phase 1 data for izicopan (formerly INF904), an oral small-molecule C5aR1 inhibitor. The SAD/MAD study enrolled 86 healthy participants; single doses of 3-240 mg and multiple doses of 30 mg QD, 30 mg BID and 90 mg BID for 14 days were well tolerated, with dose-dependent exposure and rapid, sustained C5a/C5aR1 inhibition. No transaction, board recommendation or advisor is involved; this is a routine clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation.
